description: This file defines a LinkedList class implementing a basic linked list data structure in Kotlin, including methods for adding, removing, retrieving elements, and size calculation.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A singly linked list implementation with methods to add, remove, get elements, and compute its size.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the specified element from the list, returning true if successfully removed.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index.

inner_classes.name: Node
inner_classes.description: A nested class representing a node in the linked list, containing data and a reference to the next node.

companion_object.name: tail
companion_object.description: A helper function to find the last node in the list starting from a given head node.
